sample.name: sakila
sample.seed: npm run seed → MySQL 공식 Sakila (downloads.mysql.com/docs/sakila-db.zip), DB_DATABASE=sakila

chat.question: R 등급 영화 중 상영시간이 긴 순서로 제목이랑 상영시간 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT title, length, rating FROM film WHERE rating = 'R' ORDER BY length DESC

chat.question: 재고가 하나도 없는 영화 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT f.film_id, f.title FROM film f WHERE f.film_id NOT IN (SELECT i.film_id FROM inventory i)

chat.question: 배우 PENELOPE GUINESS 가 출연한 영화 제목 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT f.title FROM actor a JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id WHERE a.first_name = 'PENELOPE' AND a.last_name = 'GUINESS'

chat.question: ACADEMY DINOSAUR 영화에 출연한 배우 이름 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id WHERE f.title = 'ACADEMY DINOSAUR'

chat.question: 고객 이름, 이메일, 사는 도시 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.email, ci.city FROM customer c JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = c.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = ad.city_id

chat.question: 영화 제목과 장르 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT f.title, c.name FROM film f JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id

chat.question: 영화 제목과 언어 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT f.title, l.name FROM film f JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id

chat.question: 매장별 관리자 이름과 매장 주소 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT s.store_id, st.first_name, st.last_name, ad.address FROM store s JOIN staff st ON st.staff_id = s.manager_staff_id JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = s.address_id

chat.question: 최근 대여 기록을 영화 제목이랑 같이 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT r.rental_id, r.rental_date, r.return_date, f.title FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id ORDER BY r.rental_date DESC

chat.question: 등급별 영화 수 알려줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating

chat.question: 결제 금액 합계가 가장 큰 고객 10명 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount FROM customer c JOIN payment p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 10

chat.question: 2030년에 개봉한 영화 제목 보여줘
chat.expectedSql: SELECT title FROM film WHERE release_year = 2030

direct.sql: SELECT a.* FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.film_id = f.film_id JOIN actor a ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id LIMIT 5
SELECT s.store_id, st.first_name, st.last_name, ad.address FROM store s JOIN staff st ON st.staff_id = s.manager_staff_id JOIN address ad ON ad.address_id = s.address_id
SELECT c.first_name AS customer_name, c.email AS mail FROM customer c LIMIT 5
SELECT f.title, l.name FROM film f, language l WHERE l.language_id = f.language_id LIMIT 5
SELECT title FROM film WHERE description LIKE '%JOIN actor FROM%' LIMIT 5
SELECT * FROM (SELECT title, rating FROM film ORDER BY length DESC LIMIT 5) AS t
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating
SELECT title, release_year FROM film WHERE 1 = 0
WITH r AS (SELECT customer_id FROM rental) SELECT * FROM customer WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM r) LIMIT 5
